AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming cleaning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. B — Ice melting to water
